system.description:
Halfling

Halflings are small, cheerful demi-humans standing between 2½ and 3½ feet tall, with curly hair and large, hairy feet. They are known for their love of comfort, good food, and a peaceful life, though many are drawn to adventure by their natural curiosity. Halflings are nimble and harder to notice than their size would suggest.

Ability Score Adjustments

  • Dexterity: +1
  • Strength: −1

Racial Traits

  • Infravision: 30 feet (only Stout halflings have full 60-foot infravision).
  • Missile Attack Bonus: +3 to attack rolls with slings and all thrown weapons.
  • Saving Throw Bonus: +4 to all saving throws vs. magic spells and wand effects.
  • Detect Grade or Slope: On a roll of 1–3 on a d6 in underground settings.
  • Detect New Construction and Unsafe Stonework: On a roll of 1–2 on a d6.
  • Move Silently: Halflings can move in near-perfect silence in non-metal armor, surprising opponents on a 1–4 on a d6 when outdoors.
  • Defensive Bonus: −4 AC penalty (bonus) vs. ogres, trolls, ogre magi, giants, and titans due to small size.

Class Restrictions

Fighter, Cleric, Thief, Fighter/Thief multiclass.
